content.user_title: Monitor SEO Performance and Configure Alerts
content.value_statement: SEO teams struggle to compare performance consistently and detect meaningful declines. This skill creates source-labeled reports and threshold-based alert plans from supplied or connected data.
actual_capabilities: Infers report or alert mode from the request and asks for clarification when intent is ambiguous.
Compares current and prior SEO or GEO metrics while labeling each value by source.
Produces audience-focused reports covering traffic, rankings, authority, backlinks, content, and AI visibility.
Configures alert thresholds, priorities, delivery routes, cooldowns, maintenance windows, and escalation paths.
Applies fixed readback windows and control comparisons to classify observed outcomes.
Offers to save reusable monitoring summaries in a scoped memory directory.
limitations: It cannot fetch current metrics unless compatible tools are connected or the user supplies data.
It reports existing CITE and CORE-EEAT scores but does not calculate them.
Reliable reports and alerts require comparison periods, baselines, or clearly labeled estimates.
It proposes alert configurations but does not schedule or send notifications without external automation.

use_cases.title: Prepare Monthly Executive Reports
use_cases.description: Compare current and prior SEO performance, summarize material changes, and assign prioritized actions with owners.

use_cases.title: Design Early Warning Alerts
use_cases.description: Set baseline-aware alerts for traffic, ranking, technical, backlink, competitor, and AI citation changes.

use_cases.title: Build Client Performance Reviews
use_cases.description: Create audience-specific dashboards with source labels, missing-data notes, recommendations, and next-period goals.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Monthly Snapshot
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an executive SEO report for [domain], comparing the last 30 days with the prior 30 days. Mark unavailable metrics clearly.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when supplied metrics need a concise monthly summary.

prompt_templates.title: Configure Traffic and Ranking Alerts
prompt_templates.prompt: Configure traffic and ranking alerts for [domain] using my baseline data. Include thresholds, priorities, channels, cooldowns, and response plans.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a team needs practical monitoring rules.

prompt_templates.title: Review Search and AI Visibility
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare AI citations and search KPIs for [domain] across [periods]. Separate observed changes, plausible explanations, missing evidence, and recommended actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when SEO and GEO performance must be reviewed together.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate a Controlled Readback
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate [change] against [control] over [readback window]. Classify the result as Promote, Keep-testing, Rollback, or Unproven, with caveats and next-readback date.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for an advanced outcome review after a measured change.

output_examples.input: Create an executive SEO report for example.com using the supplied monthly metrics.
output: Overall status: Watch. Organic sessions fell 18 percent while conversions remained stable.
Priority action: Review the three declining landing pages and assign an owner before the next readback.
Data status: Rankings and AI citations were not supplied, so those sections remain not evaluated.

output_examples.input: Configure alerts for a mature site with stable weekly traffic.
output: Critical traffic alert: Trigger after a 30 percent weekly decline against the trailing baseline.
High ranking alert: Trigger when a priority keyword drops five positions.
Route critical alerts immediately to email and Slack, with a 24-hour duplicate cooldown.

output_examples.input: Assess a content refresh after a 28-day readback period.
output: Decision: Keep-testing. Organic clicks improved, but the gain did not exceed the control.
Caveat: Conversion data is incomplete, so the business impact remains unproven.
Next step: Continue measurement through day 56 and review the same primary metric.

best_practices: Provide current and comparison-period data with source names and freshness dates.
Use measured baselines and normal volatility when setting thresholds.
Separate observed changes from explanations, recommendations, and follow-up investigations.
anti_patterns: Do not present estimated metrics as measured values.
Do not configure alert categories that the user did not request.
Do not claim causation from a simple before-and-after comparison.

faq.question: Can this skill collect SEO data automatically?
faq.answer: Only when compatible connectors are available. Otherwise, provide analytics exports, Search Console data, ranking data, or KPI summaries.

faq.question: What is the difference between report and alert mode?
faq.answer: Report mode summarizes past performance. Alert mode defines future thresholds, priorities, routing, and response plans.

faq.question: Does it calculate CITE or CORE-EEAT scores?
faq.answer: No. It can report existing scores and trends, but specialized auditor skills must calculate them.

faq.question: What happens when required data is missing?
faq.answer: The skill marks the section as not evaluated and continues without inventing metrics.

faq.question: Can it send alerts directly?
faq.answer: It creates alert rules and routing plans. Actual delivery requires connected monitoring and notification systems.

faq.question: How does it reduce false alarms?
faq.answer: It uses trailing baselines, fixed readback windows, cooldowns, maintenance windows, and threshold tuning based on observed volatility.
